sources: recreation.gov public campsite search API, campground 10159202 (per-site catalog)

values.note: Single site $15 a night in the peak season (2026: May 23 - Sep 1) and $8 off-peak (Sep 2 - Nov 28) per recreation.gov's rate table; the Forest Service page gives only the $15. $5 per added vehicle (none for a motorcycle/ATV hitched or towed onto the site). Cash or check only, no change. Group site $50 ($25 off-peak).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/price-creek-campground ('There is a $15.00/night fee for this campground, with an additional $5.00 for added vehicles. The group site is $50.00/night.'; last updated October 1, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10159202/rates (2026 Peak Season SingleSite 15, Non-Peak Season SingleSite 8) + rec.gov notice ('cash/check only no change available $5 Extra vehicle fee'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Individual sites are first-come, first-served; only the group site is reservable on recreation.gov, Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day weekend.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/price-creek-campground ('The campground is first come-first served. The group site is reservable from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day weekend at Recreation.gov') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10159202 (notice: '16 day camping limit', 'First come first service sites'; catalog: 21 standard sites not reservable, 1 group site reservable), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10159202 (notice: 'No hook-ups'; catalog: all 22 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The Forest Service says 28 units; recreation.gov lists 21 individual sites plus one group site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/price-creek-campground ('The 28 camping units here can accommodate both tents and trailers, with a maximum trailer length of 30 feet.') + rec.gov per-site catalog (21 STANDARD NONELECTRIC + 1 GROUP), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water from hand pumps through mid-September only. Bear-resistant food storage boxes; no garbage service (pack it out). Paved campground roads.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/price-creek-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'drinking water is available from a hand pumps during summer months', 'Bear-resistant food storage boxes are available, but there are no garbage services here') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10159202 ('Hand pumps (water available thru mid-Sept)'; amenities 'Paved Roads'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Open annually from mid-June through September, weather dependent.' The Pioneer Mountains Scenic Byway is closed in winter.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/price-creek-campground (Seasons of Use; Travel Considerations: 'Scenic Byway closed during winter months.'), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS (Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF, Dillon RD) campground in shady lodgepole pine at ~7,870 ft on the Pioneer Mountains Scenic Byway (Road 73), 1/4 mi up FS Rd 2406 and 1.5 mi south of Crystal Park. No cell service. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page + recreation.gov: confirmed 28 units, 30-ft trailer max, vault toilets, hand-pump water, no hookups, $15 peak / $8 off-peak single site. Changed booking reservable true/some_sites -> false/always (only the group site is reservable; individual sites are FCFS), added the 16-day limit, season mid-June through September, $5 extra-vehicle fee and pack-out/bear-box detail. Not stated: discounts (inherited). Alerts: only standing food-storage and pallet orders. Note trimmed of restated values.
